title: SiYuan
name: siyuan
description: Note-taking app built from blocks, so any paragraph can be linked, embedded or queried from anywhere else. Markdown, backlinks, a graph view and daily notes. Source: https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan

env.name: SIYUAN_ACCESS_AUTH_CODE
env.label: Access code (required)
env.description: What you type in to open your notes, and the only thing between them and anyone who can reach the port. Make it long, or generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16

env.name: SIYUAN_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

env.name: SIYUAN_TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London. Daily notes and timestamps use it.

note: Set the access code before you deploy, since the stack won't start without one. Then open http://<your-host>:6806 (or whichever port you picked) and enter it. It takes half a minute or so to start. Every note, asset and setting lives in the siyuan-workspace volume. To change the code later, just change it here and redeploy. Docs: github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan
